$comment: Lane H2 (#311 overnight, Fable) — the six calls for lane H3's proposal page, in the shape the decisions overlay reads (`.decide > li` with a <b> title; overlay copied from notes/_PROPOSAL-apollo-mcp-2026-09-26-v2.html). Nothing here is ruled; the recommendations are the seat's. Source: notes/_lanes/312/H/H2/PROPOSAL-modes-2026-10-01.md §7.

calls.title: Door, lever, or both
options: A door at the start: the person picks Assembly or Studio before the brief
A lever mid-work only: Assembly always, Studio on request
Both: Assembly by default, the lever moved by named triggers, the way back by promotion only
calls.why: The pack already makes every Copilot declare a lane in its first reply and never change lanes silently (DESIGN-CONTRACT rule 1); the brief's skipped questions already count the decisions left open (grill-me); Claude Code, Figma and GitHub all run both a launch setting and a mid-work switch. A door on its own asks the person to know the mode before they understand the brief.

calls.title: The sub-mode lists
options: The eight as listed: Compose, Adapt, Check, Hand off; Explore, Sketch, Propose, Review
calls.why: Check's output goes back to the page (a verdict in the gate's words) and Review's goes to the record (his sentence); the pack's own skills say a gated, conformant screen can still be wrong. Adapt's test is the receipt re-hash, which Compose does not have.

calls.title: The mark on Studio outputs
options: A `mode` field in the provenance receipt plus a root attribute, read by the receipt gate: Assembly refuses a studio-marked page, Studio lists its unhashed regions
A folder convention only (Studio work lives under _fitness-test or tokens/_proposals)
calls.recommendation: Receipt plus root, read by the gate
calls.why: His 2026-07-02 lesson in the promotion queue: a tag is not a fence, the store boundary is the fence. The receipt gate already re-hashes every region, so the mark costs one field and one branch.

calls.title: The law switch in the pack's runner
options: `run-gates.py --mode assembly|studio`, the tier carried in the manifest's per-gate verdict; in studio a FAIL becomes a label in the receipt, COULD-NOT-ASK stays a refusal
No change: Studio runs only in the repo, never in the pack
calls.recommendation: The flag, with the tier in the manifest
calls.why: The engine has the promotion direction (`--strict`) and not the demotion; the runner has no tier at all (three verdicts, no tier field in the manifest). A second runner is a second pack by another name.

calls.title: Launchpad's place
options: A third mode beside Assembly and Studio
A runtime of Assembly's Hand off, with the strictest gates of the three
calls.why: It runs in someone else's product with no designer watching (route B). The seat's reading, not his; the call most likely to be wrong, because the Launchpad strand is his.

calls.title: Simulator
options: Hold the name, as he said on 2026-09-27 11:07
Assign it as the stage every output passes through, from any mode
Assign it as a Studio sub-mode for prototyping
calls.why: His words: 'We might keep simulator for something else.'

build_order_if_all_six_go_his_way: the contract rename (on-canon → Assembly, freestyle → Studio)
skills as needed: Adapt, Sketch, Hand off; Explore from lane H1
